behaviors.description: Observe disabled filesystem synchronization during export without changing public content.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent finished app, recreated empty repositories and syscall tracing available.
behaviors.expected: The flag reduces real successful fsync/fdatasync calls between matching ordinary controls while metadata, executable bytes, stdout and repository integrity remain correct.

behaviors.description: Observe disabled filesystem synchronization during promotion without changing public content.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app source, recreated empty destinations and syscall tracing available.
behaviors.expected: The flag reduces real successful sync calls between matching ordinary controls while independent metadata and executable bytes remain correct and repositories pass integrity checks.

mappings.rationale: Out-of-band syscall traces establish synchronization changes separately from independent output correctness.

surface_assertions.rationale: The flag reduces real sync syscalls while preserving the exported content.

mappings.rationale: Out-of-band syscall traces establish synchronization changes separately from public promoted content.

surface_assertions.rationale: The flag reduces real sync syscalls while preserving promoted content.
